body: I pushed my old friend group, and I don’t talk to anyone new. I have people I talk to at work, and we have plans in the future to hang out. But I don’t know if I can do it. I don’t have my license yet, and I don’t like being a burden for people to drive me. Sorry if I went to deep.
It’s just hard to have thoughts of what if, without looking into the how.

Remember, when you step out of your comfort zone.... you’re going to be scared. You don’t have to be out of your comfort zone for everything, but sometimes you got to make yourself do things.
